title: Fix the referral list
prompt: The referral list shows each visit's provider, its first diagnosis code and the patient's pulse. The function below was written for it, but it fails. Fix `solve(encounters)`.
rules: Return four columns, in this order: `encounter_id`, `provider_id`, `first_code`, `heart_rate`.
`first_code` is the first item in `diagnosis_codes`. Every visit has at least one code.
`heart_rate` is the field inside `vitals`, missing when the visit has no vitals. Keep every visit, duplicates included.
hints: Press Run and read the error: it names the position that doesn't exist.
Array positions start at 0, so the first code is at position 0.
When the error is gone, check the column names. A field picked with brackets is named `vitals.heart_rate` until you give it an `alias`.
explanation: Two bugs. Array positions start at 0, so `[1]` is the second code; on a visit with a single code it doesn't exist and Spark 4 stops with an error. Use `F.col("diagnosis_codes")[0]`. Then the pulse: a field picked with brackets is named `vitals.heart_rate`, so it needs `.alias("heart_rate")`, or write it as `"vitals.heart_rate"`, which is named after the field. Fixed: `encounters.select("encounter_id", "provider_id", F.col("diagnosis_codes")[0].alias("first_code"), F.col("vitals")["heart_rate"].alias("heart_rate"))`.
